invariants.rationale: A HashMap is always allocated (even when config limit <= 0), so result is never null.
The method always returns a Map; initially a HashMap, possibly reassigned from context.mapToPair, which also returns a Map.
If no partitionPaths are given, result is empty; otherwise, mapToPair generates one entry per partition path.
The result is empty if small file limit is non-positive, or no partition paths are provided.
If partitionPaths is non-null and non-empty, the result will map all those partition paths to lists of SmallFiles.
